name: Trip Tab
version: v1 · 2026-11-18 · first script · +2 steps: Make it mine (22 Nov)
intro:
⚠️ BEFORE STEP 1 — check you are in a test copy. Look for the small “🧪 Test copy” mark on the screen. It means this app has never seen you, which is what the steps below expect. If it is missing and the app already shows your own trips, you have opened your real app: go back to your list and tap this app's name again, rather than using a bookmark, your history, or an icon on your home screen. Starting in the wrong copy makes the early steps look broken when nothing is wrong.

Trip Tab keeps the tab for a group trip on one phone: who paid what, who owes who, and the fewest payments to square everyone. You will look around an example trip in dollars, then keep the tab for a chama outing to Naivasha in Kenya shillings — four friends, four costs, one mistake to fix — settle up, and finish the trip. Then we check it remembers everything after a reload and with no internet. All the money here is pretend. A short setup may be offered after the welcome tour, four questions you answer by tapping. Unless a step tells you to try it, tap “No thanks, just open it”.

steps.do: Look at the first screen. If a dark “Good morning” card is across the top, tap its ✕ to close it.
steps.see: A card with 🧾 says “One phone keeps the tab.”, then a few lines about trips and “No account. Nobody else has to download anything.” Under it are two buttons: “Start a trip” and “See an example trip”.

steps.do: Tap “See an example trip”.
steps.see: A yellow card at the top says “👀 This is an example trip. Try anything — nothing here is saved.” with a “Start my own trip” button. Under it is “Lake weekend”, “4 people · 6 costs · $1,284.40 spent”. In “Where everyone stands”, Maya “gets back $344.40” in green and Grace “owes $259.60” in red.

steps.do: Tap the dark “🤝 Settle up” button at the bottom of the screen.
steps.see: A card titled “🤝 Settle up” lists three payments: Grace pays Maya $259.60, Tom pays Maya $84.80, Tom pays Sam $66.40, each with a “✓ Paid” button. Below them is the same list as plain text starting “Lake weekend — settle up”. Tap “Close” at the bottom — do not tap Paid here.

steps.do: Scroll to the top and tap “Start my own trip” in the yellow card.
steps.see: The example trip is gone and a card “Start a trip” opens, with “What is the trip?”, four empty name boxes under “Who is coming?”, and “Money” set to “$ Dollars”.

steps.do: In “What is the trip?” type the words below. In the four name boxes type Wanjiru, Otieno, Achieng and Kamau, one in each. Under “Money” choose “KSh Kenya shillings”. Then tap “Start the trip”.
steps.see: A message says “Chama outing to Naivasha is ready. Add the first cost.” The card says “4 people · 0 costs · KSh 0 spent”, and all four names say “all square ✓”.

steps.do: Tap the orange “＋ Add a cost” button at the bottom. Type 8000 in “How much?”. Do NOT tap a name under “Who paid?” — just tap “Add it”.
steps.see: The grey line above the buttons says “Tap who paid. KSh 2,000 each, for all 4.” A message at the bottom says “Tap who paid.” and nothing is added yet.

steps.do: Tap “Wanjiru” under “Who paid?”. In “What for?” type the words below. Leave “Everyone, equally” as it is and tap “Add it”.
steps.see: A message says “Added · Matatu hire KSh 8,000”. Wanjiru “gets back KSh 6,000” in green, and Otieno, Achieng and Kamau each “owes KSh 2,000” in red.

steps.do: Tap “＋ Add a cost” again. In the yellow box at the top, “Quick way: type it in one line”, type the words below, then tap “Read it”.
steps.see: It says “Here’s what I understood: Otieno paid KSh 6,000 for lunch, split equally among everyone (4).” Otieno is picked, How much says 6000, What for says Lunch, and the grey line says “KSh 1,500 each, for all 4.” Tap “Add it”: the card now says “2 costs · KSh 14,000 spent”.
steps.tip: If it filled something in wrong, that is a real problem — write down exactly what you typed and what it showed.

steps.do: Tap “＋ Add a cost”. Tap “Achieng” under “Who paid?”, type 1200 in “How much?” and Sodas in “What for?”. Tap “Only some people”, then tap “Wanjiru” and “Otieno” so only Achieng and Kamau keep their ✓. Tap “Add it”.
steps.see: Before you tap Add it, the grey line says “KSh 600 each, for Achieng and Kamau.” Afterwards the Sodas cost in the list says “Achieng paid · split by Achieng and Kamau”.

steps.do: Tap “＋ Add a cost”. Tap “Kamau”, type 3000 in “How much?” and Boat ride in “What for?”. Tap “Different amounts”, and in the four boxes type 1000 for Wanjiru, 500 for Otieno, 500 for Achieng and 500 for Kamau.
steps.see: The line under the boxes turns red and says “KSh 500 still needs a person.” — the parts only add up to KSh 2,500.

steps.do: Change Kamau’s box from 500 to 1000. Then tap “Add it”.
steps.see: Before you tap Add it, the line turns back and says “✓ The parts add up to KSh 3,000.” Afterwards the card says “4 people · 4 costs · KSh 18,200 spent”. Wanjiru gets back KSh 3,500, Otieno gets back KSh 2,000, Achieng owes KSh 3,400 and Kamau owes KSh 2,100.

steps.do: 🕵️ CHALLENGE — nobody tells you which button. Otieno looks at his receipt: lunch was really KSh 6,400, not 6,000. Fix it in the app, without adding a second lunch.
steps.see: There is still only one Lunch in the list, and it says KSh 6,400. The card says “KSh 18,600 spent”. Wanjiru gets back KSh 3,400, Otieno gets back KSh 2,300, Achieng owes KSh 3,500 and Kamau owes KSh 2,200.
steps.tip: If you are stuck: tap the Lunch line in the list of costs.

steps.do: Tap “🤝 Settle up” at the bottom.
steps.see: Three payments: Achieng pays Wanjiru KSh 3,400, Kamau pays Otieno KSh 2,200, and Achieng pays Otieno KSh 100. The text below starts “Chama outing to Naivasha — settle up” and ends “Spent on the trip: KSh 18,600 (4 costs)”.

steps.do: Tap “📋 Copy the settle-up”. Then open your Notes app (or any place you can type), paste, and come back to Trip Tab. Do not send it to anyone.
steps.see: A message says “Copied. Paste it in the group chat.” What you pasted is the same three payments, word for word, with the KSh amounts.

steps.do: In the Settle up card, tap “✓ Paid” beside “Achieng pays Wanjiru”. Then tap “Close”.
steps.see: A message says “Achieng paid Wanjiru KSh 3,400 ✓”, and the payment moves down to “Already paid” with an Undo button. After Close, Wanjiru says “all square ✓”, Achieng owes KSh 100, and the top of the costs list says “🤝 Achieng paid Wanjiru back”.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: After the reload everything is still there: Chama outing to Naivasha, KSh 18,600 spent, Wanjiru all square, and Achieng owing KSh 100.
steps.tip: If a “What would you like to do?” card comes up, tap “🧾 This trip” — that is the start menu, and it is right.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Tap “🤝 Settle up”, tap “✓ Paid” beside “Kamau pays Otieno”, then tap “Close”.
steps.see: A dark strip at the top says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” A message says “Kamau paid Otieno KSh 2,200 ✓”. Kamau is now all square, and only Achieng still owes, KSh 100 to Otieno.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off. Scroll down below the costs and tap “✅ Finish this trip”.
steps.see: A small box says “Not everyone is square yet (1 payment to go).” and asks if you want to finish anyway. Tap “Cancel” — the trip stays open.

steps.do: Tap “🤝 Settle up”, tap “✓ Paid” beside “Achieng pays Otieno”, then tap “Close”.
steps.see: All four names say “all square ✓”, and a green line says “✓ Everyone is square. Nobody owes anything.”

steps.do: Tap “✅ Finish this trip”, then tap “OK”.
steps.see: A message says “Chama outing to Naivasha is put away with your finished trips.” The screen shows “Your trips”, “No trip going right now”, and under “Finished trips” your Chama outing, “4 people · KSh 18,600 · finished” and today’s date. The bottom of the page says “Trip Tab v0.1 · 2026-11-18”. Two steps left.

steps.do: Now the videos. This app has 3. Open each one and watch it right through, sound on: Explain it to me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=tripstab&mode=firsttime  Watch it work — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=tripstab  Train me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=tripstab&mode=train
steps.see: Each one talks without stopping — no long silences, no sentence starting again. The screen behind the words changes to match what is being said, and when it points at something, that thing is really there. If a video talks about a button or a screen you did not see in this app, say so — that is a real fault and one of the most useful things you can find.

steps.do: Last, the shop page everyone sees: https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/ — find Trip Tab on the “Your household” shelf and read its card.
steps.see: The name and the one-line description match the app you just used. The card says Coming soon, and that is right: Trip Tab joins the store when it passes testing. Nothing on the card promises something the app does not do. If the card and the app disagree, the card is the fault — say which bit.

steps.do: Tap the ? button at the top right, then tap “Make it mine”. If it shows “Set it up now”, tap that and answer the four questions by tapping. (If you already answered them when the app first opened, tap “Answer them again”.)
steps.see: Four questions, one at a time, each answered with one tap. At the end it says “Done — that is yours now”. Say whether the questions made sense for this app, and whether any answer you wanted was missing.

steps.do: Tap ? then “Make it mine” again, then tap “✨ Make it mine — ask for something”. Ask for one report you would really want from this app, in your own words. Answer its questions.
steps.see: It asks you a few short questions, then builds a report. Tell us: did the questions make sense, and is the report something you would actually use? If it cannot make one, write down exactly what it said.
